children: Tata Consultancy Services announced on Wednesday that it has become the Official AI and Technology Partner of the Rio Marathon, marking the Indian IT giant’s first marathon sponsorship in Latin America.

The partnership positions TCS as a technology enabler for Latin America’s largest street running event, which recently earned its first World Athletics Elite Label. TCS plans to deploy artificial intelligence, data analytics, and digital innovation capabilities at the Rio Marathon, building on its existing involvement with events such as the TCS London Marathon and the TCS New York City Marathon.

The Rio Marathon registered approximately 70,000 runners across four distances in 2026, with nearly 75 per cent of participants travelling from outside the city. The event generated a record economic impact of R$ 711 million for Rio de Janeiro. The 2027 edition will mark the race’s 25th anniversary.

TCS currently sponsors 14 running events globally, including five of the eight Abbott World Marathon Majors, engaging with nearly 700,000 runners annually. According to Brand Finance’s Marathons 50 2026 report, TCS-partnered races generated US$ 3.2 billion in economic impact for host cities in 2025, representing 53 per cent of the total produced by the world’s top 50 marathons. The events raised US$ 315 million for charitable causes.
TCS has operated in Latin America since 2002, employing over 26,000 professionals across nine countries, including nearly 7,000 in Brazil across São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Londrina.

The stock fell 0.81 per cent to ₹2,455.40 by early afternoon trade. The stock is down nearly 20 per cent over the past year and approximately 24 per cent year-to-date, significantly underperforming the Nifty 50 index. Total market capitalisation stood at approximately ₹8.89 lakh crore. TCS reported consolidated revenues exceeding US$ 30 billion for the fiscal year ended March 2026.

title: TCS bags Rio Marathon tech deal; stocks in red
